about: A 31-minute compilation of dash-cam incidents on Australian roads, under a music track. One moment is the target: a red Mazda CX-5 braking ahead on a wet motorway, its plate legible in the closest frames. Moment and plate confirmed by the owner, 2026-10-22. The plate is legible in the frame at 92 s and too small to read at 86 s, checked by eye, 2026-10-22.
